description: Na₂In₂Mo₅O₁₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.55 Å) and three longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 24°. There is one shorter (1.73 Å) and three longer (1.84 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four InO₆ octahedra and edges with four equivalent MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-54°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.11 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 24°. There is one shorter (1.76 Å) and three longer (1.83 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent In sites. In the first In site, In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are three shorter (2.19 Å) and three longer (2.20 Å) In-O bond lengths. In the second In site, In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are three shorter (2.18 Å) and three longer (2.26 Å) In-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one In atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Mo atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one In atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Mo and one In atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Mo, and one In atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaInMo₂ tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Mo atoms.
